Header.Description: 請求対象伝票 計算

SQL_STMT_U.val:
SELECT s.id, s.sales_date, s.billing_date, COALESCE(s.customer_id, i.bill_to_customer_id) AS customer_id, s.sale_specific_customer_name, s.billing_customer_id, s.standard_sales_amount, s.standard_return_amount, s.standard_discount_amount, s.standard_tax, s.reduced_sales_amount, s.reduced_return_amount, s.reduced_discount_amount, s.reduced_tax, s.remark, s.tax_rate_type, i.billing_start_date, i.billing_end_date, c.invoice_type, ( SELECT CASE WHEN COUNT(*) > 1 THEN CONCAT( ( SELECT sd2.transaction_specific_product_name FROM sale_detail AS sd2 WHERE sd2.sale_id = s.id ORDER BY sd2.id LIMIT 1 ), ' 他' ) ELSE ( SELECT sd3.transaction_specific_product_name FROM sale_detail AS sd3 WHERE sd3.sale_id = s.id ORDER BY sd3.id LIMIT 1 ) END FROM sale_detail AS sd WHERE sd.sale_id = s.id ) AS first_product_name, ( CASE WHEN COALESCE(s.standard_sales_amount, 0) + COALESCE(s.standard_return_amount, 0) + COALESCE(s.standard_discount_amount, 0) + COALESCE(s.reduced_sales_amount, 0) + COALESCE(s.reduced_return_amount, 0) + COALESCE(s.reduced_discount_amount, 0) = 0 THEN COALESCE(i.previous_balance, 0) ELSE COALESCE(s.standard_sales_amount, 0) + COALESCE(s.standard_return_amount, 0) + COALESCE(s.standard_discount_amount, 0) + COALESCE(s.reduced_sales_amount, 0) + COALESCE(s.reduced_return_amount, 0) + COALESCE(s.reduced_discount_amount, 0) END ) AS current_balance_value, 0 AS sales_receipt_type, 0 AS payment_amount
FROM invoice AS i INNER JOIN closing_calculation AS cc ON cc.customer_id = i.bill_to_customer_id AND cc.closing_day = :2 INNER JOIN customer AS c ON c.id = i.bill_to_customer_id LEFT JOIN sale AS s ON s.billing_customer_id = i.bill_to_customer_id AND s.sales_date BETWEEN i.billing_start_date AND ':3' AND (:1 = 0 OR s.billing_customer_id = :1) WHERE i.billing_end_date = ':3' AND (:1 = 0 OR i.bill_to_customer_id = :1) AND ( s.id IS NOT NULL OR i.previous_balance <> 0 )
UNION ALL
SELECT r.id, r.receipt_date, r.receipt_date, i.bill_to_customer_id, '' AS sale_specific_customer_name, r.billing_customer_id, 0 AS standard_sales_amount, 0 AS standard_return_amount, 0 AS standard_discount_amount, 0 AS standard_tax, 0 AS reduced_sales_amount, 0 AS reduced_return_amount, 0 AS reduced_discount_amount, 0 AS reduced_tax, r.remark, NULL AS tax_rate_type, i.billing_start_date, i.billing_end_date, c.invoice_type, '入金' AS first_product_name, 0 AS current_balance_value, 1 AS sales_receipt_type, COALESCE(r.amount, 0) + COALESCE(r.fee, 0) AS payment_amount
FROM invoice AS i INNER JOIN closing_calculation AS cc ON cc.customer_id = i.bill_to_customer_id AND cc.closing_day = :2 INNER JOIN customer AS c ON c.id = i.bill_to_customer_id INNER JOIN receipt AS r ON r.billing_customer_id = i.bill_to_customer_id AND r.receipt_date BETWEEN i.billing_start_date AND ':3' WHERE i.billing_end_date = ':3' AND (:1 = 0 OR i.bill_to_customer_id = :1)
ORDER BY sales_date, id;
